simulate_depth_noise: simulate realistic depth sensor noise on a ground truth depth image using the Redwood noise model
create_noise_model: create a RedwoodDepthNoiseModel instance with a configurable noise multiplier for depth sensor simulation
apply_noise_to_depth: apply the Redwood depth noise model to a numpy array or torch tensor depth image
check_sensor_type: check if a given sensor type is valid for the Redwood depth noise model using is_valid_sensor_type
undistort_depth_pixel: undistort a single depth pixel using the Redwood distortion model with bilinear interpolation
